members.title: diagnosable cockpit launches (tmux's ~16 KB command limit, fold-to-pointer), plans-tab v/w viewers, and a legible per-source cap

diagrams.title: As-built launch path: byte preflight, fold-to-pointer, typed TmuxError, exact session probes
As-built plans-tab v (terminal view) and w (offline web page), incl. the viewer-return guard
As-built launch-outcome taxonomy: blocked (amber) vs failed (red) vs launched (dim)
As-built types: TmuxError / CommandTooLongError / boundedBuffer / statusLevel / Intent.Body

before.title: Before: the brief inlined into the tmux command line, stderr discarded
Before: the plans tab had no v/w - a plan was readable only in the inline detail pane
Before: every outcome rendered Faint - a cap bounce looked identical to a crash
